title: Revalidation marks a fact moved when a sibling heading changes, turns off soft-404 detection after one failed request, and lets a corrupt provider-down record block a host
goal: With no cached previous text, factdiff.window_sections compares the sections the window can enter without reading unrelated sibling headings, so adding, renaming or removing an H2 elsewhere on the page does not fail section_unchanged for a fact whose own text and window are unchanged, while an edit to the fact's own section or the section right after it still fails it; factdiff.madeup_text does not cache a status-0 answer of the made-up sibling as a 404, so a network failure does not turn off soft-404 detection for the host's other sources; and provider.host_down ignores, or clamps to DOWN_CAP_S, a record whose until lies more than DOWN_CAP_S after its at or after now

'; new=old+'
## Delta
